premise.claim: App pods of cache runtimes without a fuse client (e.g. Mooncake) must hardcode the master address, because nothing delivers the runtime config (runtime.sh, PR #6191) into the business pod; additionally the webhook ClusterRole lacks cacheruntimes, so base.GetRuntimeInfo on a CacheRuntime dataset blocks on the cache informer until timeout.

premise.patchedComponent: pkg/webhook (new RuntimeConfigInjector plugin, handler routing, annotation collection) + charts/fluid/fluid (webhook rule, plugin profile, cacheruntimes RBAC)

See results/premise-rbac-diff.txt.

Canary asserts the current 41b47141 behavior; flips red if the author switches to hasKey semantics, then invert into a contract

new in round 4 (also flagged by Copilot at this head, verified independently here): the annotation path validates dataset names with IsDNS1035Label, so a digit-leading name like '1demo' (a legal k8s object name) is rejected, while the plugin/PVC-merge path accepts it (only length and the DNS-1123 volume name are checked, and fluid-runtime-config-1demo is a valid label). Two canaries pin both sides of the inconsistency; flip and invert if the annotation check is relaxed to IsDNS1123Label
